blocks.text: Welcome to Acme SaaS! This guide walks you through the key features and how to get your team up and running quickly.
Click the **+ New Project** button in the top-right corner. Give your project a name and choose a template or start blank.
Acme SaaS offers monthly and annual billing. Annual plans save 20% compared to monthly.
Go to **Settings → Billing** and click **Upgrade**. Your new plan activates immediately and you are billed pro-rata for the remainder of the month.
You can cancel at any time from **Settings → Billing**. Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period.
Acme SaaS connects to dozens of tools via native integrations and the REST API.
GitHub — link commits and PRs to tasks
You can export your project data at any time as CSV, JSON, or PDF.
Open the project you want to export.
Click the **⋮ More** menu in the top-right.
Exports are delivered to your email within 5 minutes for large datasets.
Acme SaaS is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant.
All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).
Enterprise plans support SSO via Okta, Azure AD, and any SAML 2.0 provider. Configure under **Settings → Security → SSO**.
